topic: Cross-Device Agent Swarm with Local LLMs

📰 Cross-Device Agent Swarm with Local LLMs

A developer replaces cloud AI APIs with a local, cross-device agent swarm using Ollama, LangChain, and AutoGen. This approach cuts recurring costs, keeps data private, and enables resilient multi-agent workflows that run on heterogeneous hardware.
